senses.exampleGloss: He has a temperature, give him a pill.

alternatives.reason: LatAm/colloquial form; in Spain it sounds old-fashioned.
The measured number; tener temperatura is the neutral way to say someone has a fever.
Older Peninsular word for feeling off-colour; not for teaching.

notes: tener fiebre is the fixed pattern; the example keeps dale as an indirect object, not a leísmo.
